name: Super Fire Pro Wrestling Special
storyline: In this Special Fire Pro, you are a rookie wrestler working his way up through the ranks. During the journey, you fall in love with the sister of a wrestler named Akira Saeba. The road to the championship bout is a struggle, with loss after loss, both inside and outside of the ring. Despite the tragedy that follows you, will you be able to discover what it means to be a wrestler?
summary: Super Fire Pro Wrestling Special was released in 1994. Wrestlers from the game are based on popular wrestlers from the WWF in addition to the WCW and several puroresu organizations. The game was only released on the Super Famicom system. The game's scenario was written by Goichi Suda, and helped make him famous with a controversial suicide plotline.
